From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for extra trial credits — suspicion of repeated trial signups

Folks — I pulled the signup/usage logs for leftfield.ai and attached a small evidence package. High level summary:

- We see 5 distinct trial accounts created in the last 30 days that map to the same billing email domain (leftfield.ai) but with different display names.
- 3 of those signups originated from IPs that cluster tightly within a single /24 and map to the same AWS region — suggests same office/vpn.
- Two accounts show patterns consistent with sandboxing: repeated short-lived keys, heavy token consumption on short windows, then abandonment.

Attachments: trial_signups_leftfield_2025-11.csv (rows: signup_id, email, ip, created_at, tokens_used)
exhibit_ip_screenshots.zip (traceroute/IP lookups and timestamps)

My read: this looks like repeated trial account creation to extend free usage rather than one consolidated trial extension. That triggers our credit-abuse policy. If the customer confirms these are all distinct teams legitimately needing separate trials, we can consider a controlled top-up; otherwise we should decline and offer a paid pilot.

Recommended next steps:
- Ask the customer to identify which accounts are official and provide contacts for each.
- Offer a paid pilot discount (15% for the first 3 months) to consolidate usage under a single contract.
- If customer doesn’t clarify within 72 hours, deny further free credits and mark these signups for manual review in our fraud system.

-Priyom
Trust & Safety Analyst
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request for extra trial credits — LeftField AI (final)

Hi Jenna — thanks for clarifying and for offering to enumerate the accounts. After reviewing Priyom’s findings and consulting with compliance, we can’t approve an unconditional top-up of trial credits at this time because:

- Our policy disallows issuing additional free credits when there’s evidence of multiple trial accounts created to extend free usage across the same organization.
- The logs show behavior consistent with account-chaining to sustain free usage beyond our standard trial.

That said, we want to keep the PoC moving. Two options we can offer immediately:
1) Consolidated paid pilot: move the active teams under a single billed project — we’ll provide a 15% pilot discount for the first three months and assign a technical support slot to speed onboarding.
2) Short, conditional top-up: we can provide a one-time 10k token manual credit if LeftField provides a verified list of the official team accounts and a single point of contact who will accept billing after the pilot. This requires acceptance of our credit-usage terms and a 72-hour verification window.

Please let us know which option you prefer. If we don’t hear back in 72 hours, we’ll close the credit-topup request and mark the recent trial signups for follow-up by Trust & Safety.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
